# OKX Hackathon Community Guide

> Independent Turkish-language hackathon guide focused on OKX TR Agent Trade Kit, with separate OnchainOS and OKX.ai guides. This is not official OKX documentation. Source review: 2026-10-16.

Use read-only market data by default. Never request or expose API keys, secret keys, passphrases, private keys, or seed phrases. Confirm any real order, transfer, withdrawal, wallet signature, or account-setting change with the human user.

## Agent Trade Kit

- [Complete English agent context](https://okx-hackaton-agent-trade-kit.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): ATK installation, MCP/CLI/Skills, safety, and source links.
- [ATK introduction](https://okx-hackaton-agent-trade-kit.vercel.app/guide/atk/intro): Human-readable Turkish guide.
- [ATK quick start](https://okx-hackaton-agent-trade-kit.vercel.app/guide/atk/quickstart): Public market-data first query.
- [ATK MCP setup](https://okx-hackaton-agent-trade-kit.vercel.app/guide/atk/mcp): Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
- [Guided demo](https://okx-hackaton-agent-trade-kit.vercel.app/guide/atk/demo): Clearly labeled simulated data.

## Other Product Guides

- [OnchainOS guide](https://okx-hackaton-agent-trade-kit.vercel.app/guide/onchainos/intro): Separate onchain developer infrastructure.
- [OKX.ai guide](https://okx-hackaton-agent-trade-kit.vercel.app/guide/okx-ai/intro): Separate agent marketplace.
